caption: The drawing shows a cluster of stylized flowers arranged in a roughly rectangular composition, framed by a thin black border. The flowers are depicted with thick, mosaic-like segments. In the upper part of the composition, there are two large red flowers with dark centers and segmented petals, surrounded by smaller red and orange flowers with light-colored or yellowish centers. At the bottom, there are two overlapping purple flowers with lighter purple and pink highlights in the petals. The flowers are set against a tan or light brown background patterned with crack-like lines. Green leaves and stems are visible near the bottom left, with dark green veins and branches. The overall style is geometric, with each petal and leaf made up of distinct, mosaic-like shapes. There is writing at the bottom right and left corners outside the framed area.
title: Hooked Rug
